score_boundary: weighted calibration-cell estimate for selection; not an executed-policy measurement

static.scope: one fixed gamma shared by all declared batches

native_unrestricted.semantics: offline calibrated, frozen deployable table; not an evaluation-set oracle
native_unrestricted.unmeasured_intermediate_batches: lower-neighbor gamma assignment, not performance interpolation

native_threshold.semantics: primary dense-style baseline: native scheduler changes draft production budget

postproposal_threshold_ablation.role: optional execution-cost ablation; does not replace native threshold baseline
postproposal_threshold_ablation.reason: full-budget proposal then truncation has different cost; direct-draft scores are inapplicable

required_evaluation: execute each frozen policy on separate runs; do not splice steps from other policies

regime.device: NVIDIA RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell Server Edition
